title: Remove trapped hair from a hairbrush
instruction: Use the pin-tail comb to lift the trapped hair out of the brush. Leave the brush clear and its pins intact.
setup: A 190 mm plastic brush with a 52 x 95 mm head and 44 nylon ball-ended pins rests on a 120 x 220 x 20 mm rubber mat. Ten loose 7.5 cm hair locks, 0.2 g each, are caught among its pins. A 200 mm plastic comb with a steel pin tail rests on 30 x 20 x 25 mm and 20 x 20 x 26 mm wooden blocks. A 120 x 110 mm plastic waste dish sits beside it. Both grippers have 2 mm silicone pad covers. Restore the photographed layout; README gives dimensions and positions.
scoring: 1.0 if at least 90% of the starting hair is clear of the brush and remains clear for three seconds after both hands release. 0.5 for at least 50% cleared; 0.25 for at least 25%; otherwise 0. Only hair loosened with the comb counts; directly handling hair while it is still caught earns no credit for that hair. Collecting loosened hair by hand is allowed. Breaking or detaching a brush pin scores 0. In a physical trial, weigh the collected hair with a 0.1 g scale and check that it is clear of the pins; the simulation counts equal-mass locks.
fidelity: Ten articulated locks group fine fibres into 1.4 mm contact envelopes. One passive 10 mN snag per lock approximates fine fibres caught at a bristle. The comb must physically lift the hair. A geometry-gated grip uses a compliant native constraint capped at 18 N and 0.24 Nm; it releases on opening or slip. Bristles bend or break. Material values are approximate; no removed-hair pose is prescribed. Grip reaction loads on the robot are omitted.
scores: Dream-1: 0; scripted demo: 1.0. Dream completed across 62 server sessions after expiry recovery.
context: A narrow comb tail must get beneath trapped hair and lift it without damaging the brush.
reset_notes: Prepare ten loose 0.20 g, 75 mm locks from one documented synthetic-wig fibre batch. Store on numbered cards. Load one per row 01–10, weaving A handleward, B tipward, C handleward, D tipward; both ends stay loose. The loading guide gives numbered top/side views and checks. A reported manual check on a similar brush took an estimated few minutes: hair stayed caught during a gentle move and lifted out with the comb without pin damage. Exact dimensions/masses were not verified and no photos are available. See the report for scope.
